cases.name: HELP prints the desktop: 29 bit-image bands whose dots are exactly the set bitmap pixels, then CHR$(15)
Options:Print Screen closes the menu, then prints the same dump
Esc stops after the band being printed and returns the printer to text mode
without a printer, HELP reports that none answers on device 4
Control Panel: printer 5 with Lowercase off; Print Screen goes to device 5, secondary address 0
the printer is saved with the desktop (record bytes 60, 61); a cold start restores it and probes device 5 for the Printer icon
a missing printer is named by its device; choosing a device that does not answer removes the Printer icon
